deIdi2b2.TEXT: row_id,mrn,pt_name,dob,note_date,note_type,author,note_text 70231,9034-1126,"REYES, MARCUS",11/30/1997,03/08/2095,PROGRESS-SOAP,fhaidari,"S: Patient Marisol (name in the header is old, patient prefers Marisol, she say registration will change) come to ED again for shortness of breath, this is visit nearly every week since December.
